text: Electronic science and technology is a discipline centered on electronic devices and their system applications, integrating knowledge from multiple fields such as physics, mathematics, and computer science. It mainly studies the movement laws of electrons, the design and manufacture of electronic devices, as well as the integration and application of electronic systems. It is one of the core basic disciplines in the information age. From chip design to communication systems, from integrated circuits to quantum electronics, this major covers all the key fields of modern technology.
